name: dropped manifest persistence and recovery

test_list.description: Persist dropped chunk metadata and exact source text in CAS, then recover it by the manifest CID.
Deduplicate identical content references while preserving duplicate chunk occurrences on recovery.
The manifest contains exactly the dropped chunks supplied by Distilled.
Reject a chunk that exceeds the configured serialized content bound without truncation.
Independently verify fetched chunk bytes against their CID before decoding.
Reject validly addressed blobs with an unsupported record kind or version.
Reject schema fields that are not declared by the versioned manifest record.
Reject manifest bytes and entry counts beyond fixed limits before allocating recovery output.
Apply the same aggregate byte cap during persistence and recovery, including repeated chunk occurrences.
Reject repeated valid chunk references when their aggregate encoded size exceeds the recovery memory budget.

inputs.name: distilled
inputs.description: Sifted chunks including the original dropped chunks.

output_description: A durable manifest CID and unique dropped-chunk CIDs; recovery restores exact chunk text, locator, source and original trust annotation after validating per-record and aggregate bounds, record kind/version, and content hashes.
